source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Check this trigger during the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase). Roll a D6 if a model in Lazarus’s unit is destroyed and Lazarus’s unit still awaits its fight activation. A 4+ keeps the destroyed model in play to fight on the same activation as Lazarus’s unit. If they have yet to fight when the phase closes, fight then. Remove the destroyed model once it has fought.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
